status: Corrected source reviewed without further runtime edits; full semantic and independent acceptance pending
findings: The helper clones the existing configuration as a single object graph, retaining map membership and references to cloned inventory entries. It does not rebuild maps.
Only four optional positional weight properties change on uniquely matched inventory identities. Frequencies, readings, contextual rules and cumulative frequency metadata remain unchanged.
Unknown, ambiguous and duplicate override identities and negative or nonfinite weights are rejected.
Overrides enter the completion candidate pool only; initial grapheme selection continues using the original configuration.
The original resolver and projected-neighbor verification remain responsible for support and semantic licenses. Positive positional support does not bypass a refusal.
knownLimitations: Corrected custom-map exclusion test and full English captures do not prove all conceivable custom configurations.
Whole-corpus quality is mixed and two original quality gates remain failed; owngs increases 61 to63.
Support-only infeasibility reaches zero, but 239 projection refusals remain; complete Q14a target is not achieved.
Experiment README still needs its stale rebuilds-maps wording corrected after the live source/evaluation freeze ends.
simplification: The small helper centralizes validation and cloning. Further rewriting would invalidate measured source without a demonstrated improvement.
